challenge.name: The Loyalty Data Audit
challenge.description: A legal audit flagged that loyalty basket data lacks valid consent records, breaking the legal basis for using it in forecasts. #requirements_reuben# demands the data contracts be fully automated and governed to enforce consent checks before any data enters the pipeline. #efficiency_emilia# argues that manual review is sufficient for now to avoid delaying the promotion planning cycle, though she might accept a middle ground if it does not stall the weekly leaflet.

output.content: The pipeline needs to run without anyone opening a console at two in the morning. I want the data contracts for the loyalty basket feed to be fully automated so that consent checks happen before any record touches the feature store. If the contract passes, the job proceeds; if it fails, the job halts and pages the on call engineer. Right now we rely on manual spot checks, which breaks the deployment cadence and leaves the forecast job exposed to silent data quality failures. Automating these checks is the only way to keep the nightly replenishment cycle stable while we scale the model retraining frequency. The more consistent the input validation, the fewer the incidents we will see during peak promotion weeks.
output.reclassify_reason: The text explicitly states that automating the checks is the "only way" to maintain stability and scale retraining, indicating that fulfilling this need beyond the basic requirement of automation (i.e., ensuring full consistency) would make the author happier by reducing incidents.
